For my salvation is close to its arrival,

et filius hominis qui apprehendet istud,
and the son of man who holds to this,

guarding his hands and not doing any evil.
Et non dicat filius advenæ qui adhæret Domino,
And let not the son of the new arrival, who adheres to the Lord,
Separatione dividet me Dominus a populo suo;
“The Lord will divide and separate me from his people.”
And let not the eunuch say,
For thus says the Lord to the eunuchs:
and they will choose the things that I will,
and they will hold to my covenant.
dabo eis in domo mea et in muris meis locum,
I will give them a place in my house, within my walls,
et nomen melius a filiis et filiabus:
and a name better than sons and daughters.
I will give them an everlasting name,
And the sons of the new arrival,
qui adhærent Domino, ut colant eum, et diligant nomen ejus,
who adhere to the Lord so as to worship him and to love his name,
omnem custodientem sabbatum ne polluat illud,
all who keep the Sabbath without profaning it,
and who hold to my covenant.
adducam eos in montem sanctum meum,
I will lead them to my holy mountain,
et lætificabo eos in domo orationis meæ;
and I will gladden them in my house of prayer.
holocausta eorum et victimæ eorum placebunt mihi super altari meo,
Their holocausts and their victims will be pleasing to me upon my altar.
quia domus mea domus orationis vocabitur cunctis populis.
For my house will be called the house of prayer for all peoples.
